item.note: the text has no title, but is referred to as thar glud skong tshogs on fol. 1r1, and again as thar glud kyi skong chung bsdus pa on fol. 11r5. pp. 47-48 are equivalent to a fol. no. 16 of an unidentified text, marginal title: mngon rtogs (p. 48 is a musical score perhaps to be connected with pp. 3-4 of the present volume). p. 50 is not marked, the printing is defective, and only a few words are legible.
